s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic breast abnormality with chronic inflammatory infiltrate
salient_findings: New 1.4-cm developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast on mammography
Mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils on histologic examination
No discrete abnormality on targeted breast ultrasonography
key_facts: 48-year-old woman with no breast symptoms
Routine screening mammography showed a new 1.4-cm developing asymmetry
Asymmetry persisted on craniocaudal and mediolateral oblique views
Targeted breast ultrasonography showed no discrete abnormality
Tomosynthesis-guided vacuum-assisted biopsy was performed
Histologic examination revealed marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate
Inflammatory infiltrate was enriched in eosinophils, with lymphocytes and plasma cells
No granulomata were present on histologic examination
Patient has a history of seasonal allergic rhinitis
Peripheral blood eosinophil levels were within the normal range

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils

shortlist.label: Sclerosing lymphocytic lobulitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic inflammatory infiltrate with lymphocytes and plasma cells

shortlist.label: Idiopathic granulomatous mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic inflammatory breast disease with mixed inflammatory infiltrate

shortlist.label: IgG4-related mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic inflammatory infiltrate with potential for IgG4 involvement

shortlist.label: Chronic inflammatory breast disease
shortlist.why_kept: Persistent asymmetry with chronic inflammatory infiltrate on histologic examination

raw.rationale: The histologic examination revealed a marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, which is consistent with eosinophilic mastitis.

rejected.label: Sclerosing lymphocytic lobulitis
rejected.why: The presence of eosinophils is not a characteristic feature of sclerosing lymphocytic lobulitis.

rejected.label: Idiopathic granulomatous mastitis
rejected.why: No granulomata were present on histologic examination, which is a key feature of idiopathic granulomatous mastitis.

rejected.label: IgG4-related mastitis
rejected.why: There is no mention of elevated IgG4 levels or other characteristic features of IgG4-related disease.

rejected.label: Chronic inflammatory breast disease
rejected.why: While the patient has a chronic inflammatory infiltrate, the specific features of the case, such as the presence of eosinophils, are more consistent with eosinophilic mastitis.
